# auth-zitadel

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> Zitadel — Cloud-native Identity Provider with built-in user management
>
> Replaces GoTrue and complements oauth2-proxy as the OIDC provider.
> Provides what oauth2-proxy lacks: user creation, RBAC, service accounts.
>
> Architecture:
> Zitadel (IdP + user DB + RBAC)
> ↓ OIDC
> oauth2-proxy (Traefik middleware, unchanged)
> ↓ ForwardAuth
> Protected apps
>
> oauth2-proxy changes only its provider config:
> provider: google → provider: oidc + oidc-issuer-url: https://zitadel.{domain}
>
> Zitadel concepts mapped to the factory:
> Organization  → Tenant (multi-org support for internal + external users)
> Project       → App group (ai-tools, monitoring, productivity)
> Application   → OIDC client (oauth2-proxy, open-webui, n8n)
> Role          → Access level (admin, viewer, operator)
> Service User  → Machine account (agents, pipelines, CI/CD)
>
> Zitadel uses Helm chart via Kustomize helmCharts generator.
> PostgreSQL uses the factory's own postgres component (not Bitnami Helm).
> Requires: kustomize with --enable-helm flag
>
> Usage:
> kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/components/apps/auth/zitadel
>
> Version: Zitadel v4.20.2 on chart 10.5.0 (the chart ships v4.19.2; `image.tag` pins
> the newer app). v4.15.3 fixed CVE-2026-56666 (auto-linking an external login by
> email did not check that the IdP verified the email); later releases closed more
> advisories in Login V1 and Actions V1, so the pin is the latest stable, not the
> first fixed one. Do not go below v4.19.5 and skip v4.18.0 (its setup step fails).
> Licence: AGPL-3.0 (Apache-2.0 up to v2). bootstrap.py still refuses auto_linking
> on azure and generic_oidc: that is policy, not a version workaround.
> Upgrading an EXISTING v2.x instance: docs/apps/zitadel.md, "Upgrading to v4".
>
> Dependencies (tenant overlay, or use bundles/zitadel-stack which brings them):
> - k8s/components/apps/databases/postgres (with namePrefix: zitadel-)
> - ./bootstrap (optional): users, apps and IdPs as code
>
> Tenant must provide: the contract in ./contract.yaml (ONE list of Secret names and
> keys, namespace, hostname patches, explained in docs/apps/zitadel.md and built by
> docs/examples/zitadel-tenant/). Names: zitadel-masterkey, zitadel-db-config,
> zitadel-postgres-secret, zitadel-admin-password, zitadel-bootstrap-env (optional).
> The chart generates zitadel-admin-sa itself (no manual step, no default password).
> The Login V2 service keypair (zitadel-login-service-key) is made by cert-manager
> (login-service-key.yaml); cert-manager is already required by the Ingress issuer.
>
> Namespace is NOT set here: the consumer overlay sets it (auth, identity, zitadel...).
>
> Labels on every object: app.kubernetes.io/part-of: zitadel and
> app.kubernetes.io/ait-component: zitadel.
>
> Consumer overlay example: docs/examples/zitadel-tenant/kustomization.yaml
